claim: Developmental local action validation; no independent bug discovery or general conformance claim.

repairs.change: Require transition Auto as well as empty V2 changes. Explicit/implicit empty batches request entry into joint state; they do not leave it.
Scan only legacy configuration entries, matching unchanged numOfPendingConf. This retains the implementation omission for V2 rather than fixing the implementation in the model.
Require a positive captured applied cursor before automatic leave, matching the enclosing Go branch. Zero cursor causes neither append nor failed-append pending-index retry.

retained_implementation_behavior.behavior: Restore and constructor read only ConfState.Nodes and Learners; outgoing voters, staged learners and AutoLeave are lost. Already modeled by RestoreProjection; no repair.
numOfPendingConf ignores V2. R2 aligns the model with that code behavior; it does not fix the defect.

limitations: Locally injected structurally valid states; no reachability proof from protocol Init, no full protocol checking.
Shared domains and projections permit correlated mistakes; the TLC-generated route is not an independent oracle.
Node ownership tests call the exact real helpers, but omit channel/select scheduling and proposal-channel gating.
No old-version execution adapter; saved legacy cases require API mapping before replay there.

Ghost histories/durability observers, arbitrary payload/context bytes, remote/lease reads, disk I/O failures, bootstrap/status APIs and end-to-end restart/application schedules are outside the declared projection.
No invariants were edited or checked as safety properties; listed invariant issues require later review.
